newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine central bank sees 1996 inflation 40.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine central bank sees 1996 inflation 40.5 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's annual inflation rate will slow to 40.5 percent in 1996 from 181.7 percent last year, central bank chairman Viktor Yushchenko said at the weekend.
"For the first 11 months of this year inflation was 38.5 percent, and we expect that it will be 40.5 percent for the year," he told a news conference on Saturday.
Year-on-year inflation through December 1995 was 181.7 percent.
Ukraine monthly inflation slowed to a reform-era low of 0.1 percent in June and July of this year. Annual inflation reached 10,000 percent following independence in 1991.
